description: Defines an AgentColorManager class for generating and managing consistent, accessible colors for agents, including color caching, color generation strategies, and utility methods.

classes.name: AgentColorManager
classes.description: Manages agent colors with caching, color generation, and utility functions.

methods.name: getAgentColor
methods.description: Returns a color for a given agent, generating and caching it if necessary.

methods.name: getAllAgentColors
methods.description: Returns all cached agent colors for display.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears the color cache and used hues.

methods.name: cleanupUnusedAgents
methods.description: Removes inactive agents from cache based on provided list.

methods.name: getAgentKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for an agent based on name and ID.

methods.name: generateAgentColor
methods.description: Generates a color for an agent using predefined colors or hash-based method.

methods.name: generateHashBasedColor
methods.description: Creates a color based on string hash and golden ratio for distribution.

methods.name: ensureColorSeparation
methods.description: Adjusts hue to ensure sufficient color difference from existing colors and avoid status hues.

methods.name: createColorVariants
methods.description: Creates different color variants (primary, background, border, text) from HSL values.

methods.name: getAgentInitials
methods.description: Returns initials for an agent name for badge display.
